請問您想知道的是哪一個「冰河時期」？  
- 若是指最後一次冰盛期（約 2 萬年前的高峰），  
- 或是整個更新世（約 258 萬年至 1.17萬年前）？
message.reasoning:
User asks: "計算冰河時期是多少年前？" Means "Calculate how many years ago was the ice age?" They want to know the time period of the ice age? Probably they refer to the last glacial maximum or the Pleistocene epoch? The question is ambiguous. We can interpret as "How many years ago was the last ice age?" That would be around 20,000 years ago (peak). Or maybe they want the entire Pleistocene era which lasted from about 2.58 million to 11,700 years ago. But the phrase "冰河時期" could mean "Ice Age" generically. So we need to ask clarifying question: "Which ice age are you referring to? The last glacial maximum (~20k years ago) or the entire Pleistocene (~2.58M to 11.7k years ago)?"

We should ask clarifying question.
